step1_figure.circuit_type: Common-Source Amplifier with Current Source Load
step1_figure.description: An NMOS common-source amplifying transistor (M1) loaded by a PMOS current source load (M2) biased by Vbias1 from the wide-swing bias generator (Fig. 20.43 / SUB_1), configured with a large feedback resistor R1 and AC coupling capacitor C2 for operating point stability.

small_signal_voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency small-signal voltage gain of the common-source amplifier with current source load

equation.explanation: The voltage gain is determined by the transconductance of input NMOS M1 driving the parallel output resistance of M1 and load PMOS M2.
equation.assumptions: Both M1 and M2 are biased in saturation, neglecting body effect and external load resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: For I_D ≈ 20 µA, λ_n = λ_p = 0.1 V^-1: r_o1 = 1 / (λ_n * I_D) = 500 kΩ, r_o2 = 1 / (λ_p * I_D) = 500 kΩ, giving r_o1 || r_o2 = 250 kΩ. With V_ov1 ≈ 0.2 V, g_m1 ≈ 2 * I_D / V_ov1 ≈ 200 µA/V. Gain A_v = -200 µA/V * 250 kΩ = -50, which is |A_v| ≈ 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Channel length modulation and bias point variations in 130nm process give typical intrinsic stage gains between 25 dB and 40 dB.

open_circuit_gain.description: Maximum intrinsic gain attainable with the amplifying transistor M1 alone loaded only by its own r_o

equation.explanation: Represents the fundamental single-transistor limit when the active load impedance is infinitely large (e.g. cascoded load).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Intrinsic MOSFET gain g_m * r_o on SKY130 with channel lengths L ~ 1-2 µm typically spans 35 to 45 dB.

output_resistance.description: Small-signal output resistance at the high-impedance drain node

equation.formula: R_o = r_o1 || r_o2 = 1 / (lambda_n * I_D + lambda_p * I_D)
equation.explanation: Both M1 and M2 drain terminals connect to Vout, creating a high-impedance node equal to the parallel combination of their drain-source resistances.
equation.assumptions: M1 and M2 operate in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_D ≈ 20 µA, λ = 0.1 V^-1, r_o1 = r_o2 = 500 kΩ → R_o = 250 kΩ.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dependence on channel length and actual drain current sets R_o in the hundreds of kΩ range.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage across a load capacitor CL

equation.explanation: In Class A operation, when M1 shuts off, the maximum charging current supplied to the output load capacitance is limited by the current source M2.
equation.assumptions: M1 is completely switched off during the positive charging transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: For I_D = 20 µA and C_L = 1 pF: SR = 20 µA / 1 pF = 20 V/µs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct ratio of nominal bias current (20 µA) to a standard 1 pF load capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive testbench verifying operating point, small-signal AC gain, 3dB bandwidth, output resistance, and transient slew rate with a 1 pF load.
